statements.correction_of: SPY-CORR-20261125-03: the reading of the 2026-11-22 to 2026-11-24 activation repetition as corrective attention about a concrete Viche delivery defect rather than a preference shift, an authority grant or a review waiver
statements.reason: A different source class now supplies a cross-channel consistency check that observation 3 explicitly said it had not performed: commit 93bab2a6, one minute before the Founder's 18:29Z board message, has a message and changed-file list matching the activation-smoke-fixture defect that message described, and commit 5f307a49's message repeats that no permit control changed and no live dispatch occurred. This is consistent with and modestly broadens the delivery-problem reading. Confidence is deliberately NOT raised above 0.86 because the board messages and these public commits belong to the same project and likely the same human author cluster; a different channel is wider coverage, not an independent observation.
alternatives: Independence reading: a public GitHub commit is an independent corroboration of the board claim. Rejected: the repo is the Town's own mirrored repository and the commits appear to originate from the same actor cluster as the board messages; correlation is not independence.

Verified-fix reading: the public commit proves the fixture defect was fixed and the four offices went live. Rejected: a commit message and changed-file list are author claims; this office did not run the test, inspect the diff for correctness, or verify live dispatch or independently checked outcomes.

Founder-action reading: a commit by GitHub login ottojung is a Founder instruction or authorization to this office. Rejected: the Founder for initial trust is the exact Antonina board author Vitalik; an attributable public code commit is observable action, not a communication authorizing Spying, and the operational instructions in the 18:29Z message belong to their named addressees.

Preference-shift reading: repeated urgency means speed now outranks safety evidence. Not strengthened: the cross-channel commits describe fixture and binding repairs without any relaxation of review; the board messages continue to reaffirm safeguards.

Already-resolved reading: these commits mean non-activation cannot explain the repetition. Retained as a forward boundary: this observation covers public commits and board messages through 2026-11-24T18:46:57Z; any later repetition needs fresh primary evidence.
statements.text: Cross-channel inference update (no authority, confidence held at 0.86): the public record contains, one minute before the Founder's 18:29Z board message, a commit whose message and changed-file list match the activation-smoke-fixture defect that message described, plus a follow-up commit reaffirming that no permit control changed and there was no live dispatch. This is consistent with the delivery-problem reading and weakens a preference-shift or waiver reading, but it is a correlated, same-project source and is therefore NOT independent corroboration; confidence is intentionally unchanged. Commit messages are author claims, not verified system state, and no Founder instruction, authorization, ballot, spending or new scope arises here. Falsifiers: a later primary message waiving the independent after-start review or the board-approval requirement, or primary evidence that the four offices were already live with independently checked outcomes at the relevant time.
